name: Janata Stationery & Art Bandra
description:
Established in 1970, Janata Book Centre was started by Late.Khimji Lalji Chheda which specialized in
school and college books along with school and office stationery.
Later in 1988 Mr.Ashok Khimji Chheda s/o Khimji Lalji Chheda joined the family business and introduced
a range of fine art and craft materials.
As the demand for fine art materials increased, slowly we started to focus on the fine art range.
Now we specialise in Fine Art, Architectural, Interior, Jewellery, Fashion Designing Materials, School & Office Stationery. Now the store is also known as “Janata Stationery & Art"
Soon Mr. Chheda inaugurated another store for All types of Papers & Craft Materials known as "Veerat Paper Bazar"

featured_reviews.name: Sheldon Dias
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located in the St. Pauls Media Complex, St Paul Book And Art Centre Mumbai is a serene landmark that serves as a one-stop destination for spiritual literature and religious artifacts. It is particularly well-regarded for its peaceful, library-like atmosphere, offering a quiet refuge for visitors to browse through a wide range of specialized materials.
• Diverse Collection: The store is a major hub for religious and spiritual books, including Bibles in various editions, theological texts, and Catholic literature, as well as academic titles, CBSE textbooks, and children's storybooks.
• Art and Gifts: Beyond literature, it features an extensive selection of religious artifacts, such as statues, rosaries, candles, and framed prints, making it a popular spot for meaningful gifts and church supplies.
• Holiday Highlights: During the Christmas season, the first floor transforms into a festive destination stocked with unique décor, souvenirs, and seasonal ornaments.
• Supportive Environment: Visitors frequently mention the well-organized layout and the helpful, professional staff who are knowledgeable about the inventory and assist with niche title requests.

featured_reviews.name: Haider Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Veerat Paper Bazar is a popular stationery store located in Bandra, Mumbai. It has been serving the local community for over 50 years and has been a favorite destination for school and office supplies. The store offers a wide variety of stationery ranging from pens, pencils, notebooks, diaries, folders, art supplies, and more. The store also stocks a range of computer accessories such as printers, scanners, and USB sticks.

The store is known for its friendly and helpful staff who are always willing to assist customers in selecting the right products. They are also available to answer any queries and help customers with their purchase. The store has a large selection of products and offers competitive prices. It is a great place to shop for all your stationery needs.

The store is conveniently located in the heart of Bandra and is easily accessible by public transportation. It is open seven days a week from 9am to 8pm and till 9pm on weekends. The store is well-lit and clean and it is easy to find the items you need. Parking is also available for customers who come by car.

Veerat Paper Bazar has become a popular destination for all stationery needs in Bandra.

Even tho i was the lone customer he was hurrying me to buy and get out. Also the papers were not A1 size as i had specified. All in all a great place but check everything. featured_reviews.name: B M
featured_reviews.review_text:
The shop does have a decent collection. But its billing and accounting systems are poor. They gave a GST bill, failed to provide ITC (GST credit) to customer. And after reminders, instead of solving the problem, they expect the customer to follow up with their accounts department. The sales team at the shop, are least bothered, of the customer service standards, in such matters.

REPLY to your REPLY: I messaged and called politely, after the tax deadline expired and I had not received my ITC. No reply from your team. So I followed up after a few days. Was given a phone number. Messaged on that number. Was given another phone number. I messaged them. They did not reply; nor did they answer a call. Why would I have 3 phone numbers for your shop, unless you were sending me from person to person. In any case, if your team had followed all the proper tax procedures on time, I would not have had to message or call you even once. Despite what you think, I have zero desire to speak to someone being rude to me, even once, let alone the 4 times that I spoke on the phone to you or your colleagues.

featured_reviews.name: bhalchandra kholambe
featured_reviews.review_text:
Not a good experience.
They seem to have tie-ups with schools for selling books, but when you go to buy notebooks or books, they give you a full bundle without properly explaining what is actually required for the academic year.
Because of this, last year I ended up with around 12 extra books that were not needed. When I went back to request an exchange, the staff was not cooperative and refused to help.
Overall, poor customer service and lack of proper guidance. I would not recommend buying full bundles from here—better to confirm the exact book list before purchasing...
